metadata.description: Personal Claude Code skills and commands.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Polish raw text into a clean message, proofread posts before publishing, draft messages in your voice, and copy answers to the clipboard.

plugins.name: boards
plugins.description: Read tickets and boards from the tools they live in. Currently Notion pages.

plugins.name: context
plugins.description: Decide what a conversation should leave behind: a memory entry, a repo context file, a skill, or nothing.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Download and summarize videos from YouTube, X, Instagram and other sites, and transcribe Apple Voice Memos, with local transcription on Apple silicon.

plugins.name: slides
plugins.description: Build a plain HTML slide deck: agree an outline first, then 16:9 slides that scale to any screen, carry one visual each and print one per page.
